From 00:00:43.000 it is a wide shot, showing his surroundings, eating under a shelter in the jungle. I'll make sure to note what he is eating, and any actions he takes as he is finishing his meal. I must include what he looks at or what he touches, if anything, as it is key visual data. There is an absolute limit of 60 seconds total. All the captions must be very specific for each second.
